title: Attention to Employment Prospects for Persons with Special Needs amidst COVID-19 Pandemic
what_it_is: Attention to Employment Prospects for Persons with Special Needs amidst COVID-19 Pandemic

sections.label: Retrenchment and re-entry rates
sections.summary: MOM survey data shows 4.9 residents retrenched per 1,000 resident employees in the first half of 2020, with a 61.4% re-entry rate versus 63.2% a year earlier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Based on the latest available survey data from MOM, there were 4.9 residents retrenched per 1,000 resident employees in the first half of 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The re-entry rate of retrenched residents in the first half of 2020 was 61.4%, lower than that in the same period a year ago, which was at 63.2%.

sections.label: Taskforce reached affected workers
sections.summary: In the first half of 2020, the Taskforce reached out to about 8,200 affected workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In the first half of 2020, the Taskforce reached out to about 8,200 affected workers.

sections.label: Wage offsets for hiring PWDs
sections.summary: The EEC will give employers hiring Singaporean PWDs earning below $4,000 a month wage offsets of up to 20% of monthly income.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The EEC will provide employers that hire Singaporean PWDs earning below $4,000 a month with wage offsets of up to 20% of the employee's monthly income.

sections.label: Statistical reliability for PWD data
sections.summary: Getting unemployment or employability data involves statistical reliability angles, and the PWD segment is very small.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Because to get the data on unemployment or employability, all these have certain angle of statistical reliability which, in the case of the PWD, is a very small segment.

sections.label: Training grant and PWD assistance
sections.summary: A SG Enable training grant supports up to 90% of co-workers, and help will be rendered to those who come forward and ask for it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As an example, there is a training grant under SG Enable curated training courses where we support up to 90% of co-workers to build up their capabilities and confidence in hiring and integrating PWDs into the workplace.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chong Kee Hiong (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: As persons with special needs or disabilities are more vulnerable, particularly during periods of crisis, does the Ministry have case managers to follow up with those who lose their jobs or who have been retrenched so that you can render direct assistance?

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Certainly, for those who have come forward and ask for help, we will render the help.

sections.label: Speeding up work group progress
sections.summary: Because of the GE and changes, results and progress updates are not there, so the Ministry is asked to speed up the work group.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: — because of the GE and the changes, the results and the progress updates are still not there.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: Hence, I request the Ministry to speed up the work of this work group and get those things that can get going, get going first, so that those things that need discussion do not have to wait till the expiry of the Enabling Masterplan.
